name: humanizer-plugin
description: Codex plugin with an anti-slop humanizer and a conservative form-only humanizer.

interface.shortDescription: AI-writing cleanup with a form-only option.
interface.longDescription: Two Codex writing editors: Humanizer removes common AI-writing patterns with fact-safe checks, while Humanizer Form makes minimal surface edits and preserves every supplied claim, opinion, qualifier, attribution, and logical relation.
defaultPrompt: Use $humanizer-form to improve the wording without changing the substance:
Use $humanizer to audit and score this draft for AI-writing patterns.
